avis.titre: My Skin Started Looking Like I Actually Get Enough Sleep ✨🍊
avis.texte: I’ve tried a lot of vitamin C serums over the years, and this one has quickly become a favorite. The texture is lightweight, absorbs fast, and doesn’t leave that sticky “my face could trap lint” feeling some serums have. The little vitamin capsules melt right into the skin and make the serum feel a bit more luxurious than your average skincare step. After using it consistently, my skin started looking brighter, smoother, and more even overall. It gives a healthy glow without making me look greasy or overly shiny. I also appreciate that it feels hydrating in addition to brightening. My skin is dry, and this layered nicely with moisturizer without irritation or tightness. The formula feels gentle enough for everyday use, which I have done for over a month now. Overall, this serum makes my complexion look fresher and more awake — like I drink green juice and make good life choices, even when I don't always...

avis.titre: So far loving it and LOVE this brand!
avis.texte: I’ve been using this Vitamin C serum for a short amount of time now, but I’m already really impressed with how well it’s working so far. A little truly goes a long way—you only need a small amount to cover your entire face, which makes it feel like it will last quite a while. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any sticky or greasy feeling behind, which I really appreciate. One of my favorite things about this serum is the scent. It has a fresh, pleasant smell that isn’t overpowering, making it enjoyable to use both morning and night. So far, this has been a great addition to my skincare routine, and I’m excited to keep using it to see even more improvement which is why only gave it 4 stars for now!

avis.titre: A Glow Boosting Vitamin C Serum That Actually Feels Luxurious!
avis.texte: I’ve been using the medicube Deep Vitamin C Capsule Serum consistently for a few days, and it has quickly earned a permanent spot in my skincare routine. The capsule style formula is what initially caught my attention, and it truly delivers a unique experience compared to traditional vitamin C serums. It essentially has no discernable scent. The texture is lightweight yet nourishing. The tiny capsules melt seamlessly into the skin as you apply, giving an instant boost of hydration without any greasy or sticky residue. It layers beautifully under moisturizer and makeup, which is a big plus for daily use. I noticed my skin looking brighter and more even toned, with a healthy glow that wasn’t there before. It’s especially effective for dullness and fine lines, and my skin feels smoother and more refreshed overall. Despite being a vitamin C product, it’s surprisingly gentle and didn’t cause irritation on my sensitive skin. The packaging feels high end and keeps the product feeling fresh, and a little goes a long way, making it a good value for the size. If you’re looking for a vitamin C serum that combines radiance, hydration, and a luxurious feel, this one is absolutely worth trying!

avis.titre: The most brightening ingredients I have seen in a serum. Hydrating/soothing/left skin glowing.
avis.texte: I chose this Korean vitamin C serum because I struggle with skin redness and, as I have aged, my skin has lost some of its brightness. The primary ingredient (at 77%) is sea buckthorn water, which is rich in vitamin C and is hydrating. The serum also contains multiple forms of vitamin C as well as niacinamide – ingredients that promote brightening, offer anti-aging support, and strength the skin barrier. Numerous other ingredients promote hydration, and sooth and repair the skin. I have tried many serums, and this serum contains more brightening ingredients than any other serum I have tried. The serum absorbs well and does not leave the skin looking or feeling shiny or oily. As someone who is quite averse to having skin that looks or feels even remotely oily, I appreciated that this serum does neither. I found the serum to be very hydrating and soothing and, after use, my sensitive skin had a nice subtle glow to it. This has become my go-to morning serum because of its strong brightening focus. I am a big fan of Korean skin care products, which I find are almost always high-quality and affordable. Medicube is among my favorite brands, and this nutrient-rich serum is consistent with the overall quality of the brand. Considering the ingredients, I think this is a great value at $22.

avis.titre: Lots of essential oils, gentle vit c mix, mostly niacinamide doing the work
avis.texte: The Medicube Deep Vita C Capsule Serum is a brightening serum with its star ingredients being sea buckthorn water, 5% niacinamide, and a blend of multiple vitamin C derivatives, making it more gentle than a high concentration ascorbic acid serum would, though results might be slower and more subtle. I like that it also includes antioxidants, PHA (gluconolactone), and barrier-supporting ingredients such as panthenol and cholesterol. What I don't love about it? It has a large number of essential oils and botanical extracts, including citrus, rosemary, mint, and fennel oils. These might have some skin benefits but they mostly just function as fragrance components. Yes, it's great that there isn't added fragrance/parfum, but these ingredients can be irritating for folks with sensitive skin or cause the skin to become sensitized overtime. Short term this feels fine on my skin but I couldn't use it daily or long-term due to the irritants. But with all skincare, your mileage may vary! The serum itself is fun to apply due to the little suspended capsules. They melt nicely into the skin upon application. For $19, this is not the worst buy. 5% niacinamide is a solid concentration and if you don't mind EOs, then this could be a solid add to your routine if you want something gentle/entry level. It compliments the vit c capsule cream from the same line nicely if you're a big Medicube fan!

avis.titre: Great addition to a skin care routine, however slightly tacky feeling
avis.texte: I've been using this serum as directed, using it after a toner and prior to face lotion. Just a little of this serum will go a long way, so the bottle will last for awhile even with daily use. Pros: The serum is non-irritating and hasn't caused any breakouts. It has an ever so slight scent that I can't detect at all once applied. This provides great hydration, leaving my skin feeling fully moisturized after my skincare routine and looking fresh. Slight Con: This does leave my skin feeling slightly tacky, not sticky though, after applying a thin coat. I then apply a face lotion after this and it sinks into my skin just like normal, leaving the skin feeling smooth and moisturized. Overall, I would recommend this serum as an addition to your skin care routine!
